event_chain.summary: Vendor license system accessed (method not disclosed)

summary: In June 2026 Texas Cyber Command detected a cybersecurity incident at the third-party vendor that runs the Texas Parks and Wildlife Department's hunting and fishing license sales system. An unauthorized actor may have obtained driver's license information, passport numbers, email addresses, phone numbers and residential addresses of more than 3 million license holders, including TPWD staff; SSNs, dates of birth and payment card data were not affected.
